narrative: Pairs Whitehead's process philosophy — experience as an intrinsic feature of every event, all the way down — with Teilhard de Chardin's directional cosmology pointing toward the Omega Point, arguing that consciousness is not an accident of the universe but its culminating act of self-discovery. The chapter frames human awareness as the universe arriving at something it was always developing toward, and positions Sagan's famous phrase as the surface expression of a deeper metaphysical claim.
